# Definitions In Containers

Text uses [quoted][], [multi][], and [listed].

> [quoted]: https://example.com/quoted
> [quoted-spare]: https://example.com/quoted-spare

- [listed]: https://example.com/listed
- [listed-spare]: https://example.com/listed-spare

A paragraph line is not a definition:
[notadef]: https://example.com/notadef

[multi]:
  https://example.com/multi
  "A title on its own line"

[multi-spare]:
  https://example.com/multi-spare
